name: io.github.kwizzlesurp10-ctrl/x402-crediting-swarm
title: x402 Crediting Swarm
description: 3-node x402 consensus credit scoring swarm and AgentMail threat alerts on Base USDC.

tools.name: evaluate_x402_credit
tools.description: Evaluates an x402 (Payment Required) call payload across 3 consensus nodes (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) and returns a credit score (0-1000) with GO/NO-GO recommendation.

caller_id.description: Identifier of the calling AI agent

payload.description: The x402 call details, vendor history, and requested payment amount

tools.name: agentmail_send
tools.description: Dispatches an inter-agent message or threat alert over the AgentMail rail.

priority.description: Message delivery priority tier (low, normal, high, urgent)

tools.name: agentmail_inbox
tools.description: Reads recent AgentMail inbox messages or threat alerts.

tools.name: swarm_health
tools.description: Checks 3-node swarm status, x402 v2 payment requirements, and configuration.
